## Document Guide

This PRD defines the product vision, goals, personas, and functional requirements for [Product Name].

**Document Structure:**

- Sections 1–3: Executive summary, classification, domain context
- Section 4: User personas
- Section 5: Functional requirements
- Section 6: Non-functional requirements
- Section 7: Out of scope
